title: Spinach, Yoghurt and Feta Rice Paper Burekas
subtitle: baked until crisp
description: Baked rice paper rolls filled with spinach cooked with red onion, yoghurt and sumac, topped with crumbled feta. Makes 8 small or 5 large burekas.

steps.text: Heat the olive oil in a pan and fry the chopped red onion for about 5 minutes until translucent. Add the chopped spinach and cook for about 5 minutes until soft and the liquid has evaporated. Add the yoghurt, sumac, cumin, salt and pepper and keep cooking over low heat without boiling. Add the lemon juice, stir and turn off the heat. Cool to room temperature.
Fill a bowl with lukewarm water and soak one rice paper sheet at a time for about 30 seconds until soft, to avoid over-softening and tearing.
Preheat the oven to 180°C and line a tray with baking paper.

Place a rice paper sheet on a tea towel. Arrange a spoonful of spinach filling in a strip on the bottom third, with a spoonful of crumbled feta on top, leaving about 2 cm clear on each side. Fold the sides in to the centre and roll up from the bottom. Place on the tray and fill the remaining sheets the same way.
Brush the burekas with beaten egg and sprinkle with sesame seeds. Bake for about 30 minutes until browned and crisp. Serve immediately.
